en: I came to London to see the sights.
I see. May your trip be a pleasant one.
Thank you for earlier.
It's almost a bit cold tonight.
The days are quite mild, but the nights
get cold, don't they? Please take care
of yourself.
Strange,
note: Before the name + #7896 ", you're" + #10008: "Strange, {NAME}, you're / easy to spot even at night."

en: easy to spot even at night.
You draw the eye, or... no, it's that the
night suits you. Yes, I'm sure of it.
Hello? Is something the matter?
Huh? ...Oh, it's nothing.
Everything here is so new to me, I was
just lost in it, that's all.
I see. My apologies.
It seems I disturbed you by calling out.
Not at all.
My name is Anna. I'm visiting London
as a tourist.
This museum is really amazing.
I think I'll keep coming for a while.
Indeed, one day is not enough to see it all.
I hope you enjoy your trip.
Thank you. See you again.
We have in fact met before. Do you
recall, I wonder?
Disturb me? Not at all... Oh?
That's right, we met in town.
Meeting again... what a lovely twist of fate.
Anyway...
note: Standalone, because the next row #10020 also starts a sentence in msg 386006.

en: Take your time and enjoy it.
I never tire of it, no matter how often I look!
Oh, we meet again.
, so you like
museums too.
Yes, of course.
I am drawn to old and time-honored things.
So am I.
It's like touching history, and sometimes
it moves me deeply.
Oh, I'm so glad I came...
I wish I could stay here forever.
Ahaha, we meet again.
You'd think I'm here all day, wouldn't you?
Well, maybe that's not far from the truth.
I've really fallen in love with this place.
Though I'd like to see other places too.
When I graduate, I want to live in London.
Being a curator here would be wonderful.
I should have made my stay longer.
There are still places I haven't seen.
Oh, I wish I had more time.
Oh, what can I do for you?
You look much too grand for a cheap inn.
I'm just a tourist, you know.
I can't think what you'd want with me...
This place is pretty cheap. A real bargain.
Are you staying here too, by any chance?
Then they must have posher rooms too...
note: If he is a guest here too, the inn must have better rooms than hers.

en: , what's the matter?
note: After the name: "{NAME}, what's the matter?"

en: Ahaha, did you think you wouldn't find
me at the museum?
Don't worry, I'm there every day.
I hope we meet again at the museum.
Still, you and this inn are such an odd
match. It's funny.
I mean,
note: Before the name + #7896 ", you're" + #10068 (or #10095, slice 126, same text).

en: as refined as a nobleman, yet you think
nothing of coming to odd places. Ahaha.
I don't mind, so come by anytime.
Perhaps humans are drawn to history and
tradition because their lives are too short.
Then, as my servant,
I shall prolong that life of yours.
Now work for me to your heart's content.
I just wanted to take a different road.
I see. I hope you have a good trip.
I'm glad I could help. Well, goodbye.
Well, I think that's the only one.
